final: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS risk_record_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(risk_record_count) AS avg_count FROM counts) SELECT AVG(c.risk_record_count) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(c.risk_record_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM counts c CROSS JOIN avg_count a WHERE c.risk_record_count > a.avg_count
